Name: (AT) Russian Blue Kitty
Author: RaemonNoodles
Description:
[b][u](ALTERNITIVE TEXTURES) Russian Blue Kitty[/u][/b]

[b][color=#d5a6bd]What Does This Mod Do?[/color][/b]
This mod [b]changes the vanilla cats into a Russian Blue cat[/b] based off my irl kitty! There wasn't many mods that made a Russian Blue specifically so I made my own𖹭 

[b][color=#d5a6bd]How Do I Download This Mod?[/color]
[/b]Just download the file and either throw[b] it into the mods folder [/b]or use[b] the mod manager on SMAPI[/b]. SMAPI will automatically unzip the file and you can then enjoy the mod. Easy!

[b][color=#d5a6bd]How do I change my cats texture?[/color][/b]
You will [b]need Alternative Textures (AT)[/b]. Once Alternative Textures is downloaded you can [b]go to Robin's shop and buy the [u]scissors[/u] for 500c[/b]. You can then go over to your cat and click on it and it will show you my mod amongst other mods you may have downloaded for cats that use Alternative Textures!

[b][color=#c27ba0]Small Warning!⚠[/color][/b]
This mod was made on and old, hanging on by a thread mobile phone - having said that, don't expect the best lol. But don't be afraid to tell me if there are somehow glitches and other things wrong with the mod.

[b][color=#d5a6bd]Other mods seen in the pictures are -[/color][/b]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21531]PinkStations Cotton Candy Recolor[/url] (For trees, grass, etc) and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26016]Delaney's Energetic Buildings[/url] (For the pet bowl)
